sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the applicants submitted that offence is punishable upto seven years of imprisonment.
Earlier bail application was dismissed granting liberty to applicants to file repeat bail application after filing of charge-sheet.
It is submitted that charge-sheet has been filed and investigation is complete and allegations made against applicants are not serious in nature.
It is also submitted that applicants are innocent and have falsely been implicated in the case.
Hence, they may be granted bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the bail application and submitted that applicants are having criminal antecedents.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. Offence is punishable upto seven years of imprisonment and applicants are in jail since 08.07.2023.
Investigation in the case is complete and charge-sheet has also been filed.

6 . Considering aforesaid circumstances of the case, without commenting on merits of the case, bail application filed by applicants is allowed on following conditions:-
(i) Applicants will mark their presence on first of every month before local police station.
(ii) If applicants are found to be involved in any other offence in future, then prosecution will be at liberty to file an application for cancellation of bail granted to them today.

7. It is directed that applicants be released on bail on aforesaid condition on furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rs. fifty thousand only) each with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for their regular appearance before concerned Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial.
